title: Puerto Rico: El Yunque and the bays that glow
goal: Describe the rainforest, bioluminescent bays and karst of Puerto Rico with cleft sentences (*Lo que…*, *Fue … cuando*).
grammar: cleft sentences, applied to Puerto Rico's nature

items: I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence (*Lo que… es…*, *Fue… cuando…*).
I can say what El Yunque and the bioluminescent bays are and why they are special.
I can use the new words for the coquí, the parrot and the karst.
